prompt: Build a 4-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 4 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.2*Z0 - 0.4*Z1 + 0.3*Z2 + 0.1*Z3 + 0.5*Z0*Z1 + 0.3*Z2*Z3 (single-qubit 'field' terms plus two pairwise coupling terms). gamma = 0.45. Any correct implementation is accepted (every term is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the correct combined phase per computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition). No measurement.
